catalogue.name: Rider's Wells

description:
The Rider's Wells keep horses rested, watered, and ready for war. It reduces cavalry training time in this village by 1% per level.
At level 10, all Sentinels consume 1 less food per hour.
At level 15, all Sun Riders consume 1 less food per hour.
At level 20, all Crimson Lancers consume 1 less food per hour.
